subject.title: fix(gateway): bound connect frame auth.* fields at the protocol schema

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's gateway connect auth caps and token-shape restrictions as the new protocol contract for pre-auth auth fields?
rationale: The implementation looks correct, but the exact protocol caps intentionally reject outlier existing auth values and sit on an auth/security boundary that should be owner-accepted before merge.

options.title: Accept Current Caps
options.body: Proceed with the current 256 bootstrap/device cap, 2048 runtime-token cap, and 4096-code-point shared-secret cap after owner review.

options.title: Adjust Compatibility Bounds
options.body: Ask the contributor to widen or document any cap where gateway/security owners believe existing deployments could reasonably exceed the proposed contract.

options.title: Pause This Direction
options.body: Hold or close the PR if maintainers do not want schema-level auth field rejection without a broader protocol/versioning plan.

recommendation.title: Accept Current Caps
recommendation.body: Proceed with the current 256 bootstrap/device cap, 2048 runtime-token cap, and 4096-code-point shared-secret cap after owner review.

likelyOwner.reason: The bootstrap-token pairing flow and security hardening history make this the best available owner signal for the protocol/auth boundary decision.
